headline: A big first down for Kansas City
what_happened: K.Walker ran the ball forward 5 yards, which gives the Chiefs a new set of four tries called a first down.
who: K.Walker carried the ball while being stopped by C.Bynum.
why_it_matters: This keeps the Chiefs' drive alive as they look to break the tie, though their overall chance to win dipped slightly by 1 percentage point on this play.
